speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
question: What rises-sets at once within You alone?
premises: Within You-alone-one, throbbing-glory knowledge-ocean, wave-taste spreading by own taste.
They — creations-keepings-dissolvings-formed, moon-sun-fire clash-gleams at once: rise-set powers (SD tavaikasyāntaḥ variant).
inference: Ocean within; moon-sun-fire rise-set at once.
uncertainties: Print tavaivaikasyāntaḥ followed; SD variant noted.
